# Rnssp

## Overview

The **Rnssp** R package is a catalog of data processing and analytics
tools, templates, and functions commonly used across the National
Syndromic Surveillance Program at the Centers for Disease Control and
Prevention (CDC). Its goal is to improve code reproducibility,
standardize and document reusable functions, facilitate the sharing of
routine reports across the NSSP Community of Practice (CoP), and better
engage the NSSP CoP.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `Rnssp` from GitHub:

``` r
# Install the Rnssp package
devtools::install_github("cdcgov/Rnssp@dev")
```

To install the package for Webassembly, run the following in your `webr`
REPL or add it to your
[`shinylive`](https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/) application:

``` r
# Install the Rnssp package for webr
webr::install("Rnssp", repos = c("https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp-wasm", "https://repo.r-wasm.org"))
```

## Usage

This is a basic example which shows you how to:

- use the `Rnssp` package to create a user profile
- and use the user profile to pull data from an API (here the ESSENCE
  API)

``` r
library(Rnssp)

## Creating a user profile (token)
myProfile <- create_token_profile()

## Creating a user profile (username and password)
myProfile <- create_profile()

## Inspect your `myProfile` confirming that username and password are completely hidden
myProfile

## JSON URL from ESSENCE API
url <- "https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/alerts/regionSyndromeAlerts?end_date=31Jan2021&start_date=29Jan2021"

## Update Start and End dates in ESSENCE API URL
url <- change_dates(url, start_date = Sys.Date() - 30, end_date = Sys.Date())

## Pull Time Series Data from ESSENCE
api_data <- get_api_data(url) # or api_data <- myProfile$get_api_data(url)

## Inspect data object structure
names(api_data)

## Get a glimpse of the pulled dataset
glimpse(api_data$regionSyndromeAlerts) 
```

## Contributing to this project

Should you want to contribute to this project, submit a push request to
this Github repository and consider submitting a request to be added as
a developer to <gazondekon@cdc.gov>.

## Getting Help

If you encounter a clear bug, please consider emailing the author at
<gazondekon@cdc.gov> and/or file an issue with a minimal reproducible
example.

# Package index

## Exported Functions

Functions exported by the Rnssp package

- [`add_rmd_template()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/add_rmd_template.md)
  : Utility to Add a New RMarkdown Template
- [`alert_ewma()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/alert_ewma.md)
  : Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA)
- [`alert_farrington()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/alert_farrington.md)
  : Farrington Temporal Detector
- [`alert_nbinom()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/alert_nbinom.md)
  : Negative binomial detection algorithm for weekly counts
- [`alert_regression()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/alert_regression.md)
  : Adaptive Multiple Regression
- [`alert_serfling()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/alert_serfling.md)
  : Original Serfling method for weekly time series
- [`alert_switch()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/alert_switch.md)
  : Regression/EWMA Switch
- [`askme()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/askme.md) :
  Password Prompt Utility
- [`change_dates()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/change_dates.md)
  : Utility to Change the Start and/Or End Dates in an ESSENCE API URL
- [`classify_trend()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/classify_trend.md)
  : Trend Classification for Proportions/Percentages
- [`create_profile()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/create_profile.md)
  : Create a profile with a username and password
- [`create_apikey_profile()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/create_apikey_profile.md)
  : Create a profile with an API key
- [`create_token_profile()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/create_token_profile.md)
  : Create a profile with an API token
- [`explain_url()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/explain_url.md)
  : Parse and Explain URL Query Parameters
- [`get_api_data()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/get_api_data.md)
  : Get API data
- [`get_api_graph()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/get_api_graph.md)
  : Get an API graph
- [`get_api_response()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/get_api_response.md)
  : Get API response
- [`get_essence_data()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/get_essence_data.md)
  : Get ESSENCE data
- [`list_apps()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/list_apps.md)
  : List Available Shinyapps
- [`list_templates()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/list_templates.md)
  : List Available Report Templates
- [`remove_rmd_template()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/remove_rmd_template.md)
  : Utility to Remove an Existing RMarkdown Template
- [`Rnssp`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/Rnssp.md) : Tools,
  Functions, Shapefiles data, and Rmarkdown templates to work with
  Syndromic Surveillance data
- [`Rnssp_vignettes()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/Rnssp_vignettes.md)
  : Browse Rnssp vignettes
- [`run_app()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/run_app.md) :
  Run embedded shiny applications
- [`webscrape_icd()`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/webscrape_icd.md)
  : ICD Code Web Scraper

## Exported Classes

Classes exported by the Rnssp package

- [`Apikey`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/Apikey.md) :

  An `Apikey` Class Representing an Apikey object

- [`Auth`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/Auth.md) :

  An `Auth` Class is an abstract authentication class

- [`Credentials`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/Credentials.md)
  :

  A `Credentials` Class Representing a Credentials object

- [`NSSPContainer`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/NSSPContainer.md)
  :

  A `NSSPContainer` Class to store a value or an object

- [`Token`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/Token.md) :

  A `Token` Class Representing a Token object

## Available Datasets

Datasets contained in the Rnssp package

- [`cbsa_sf`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/cbsa_sf.md) : US
  Core-Based Statistical Area Shapefile
- [`county_sf`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/county_sf.md) :
  US Counties Shapefile
- [`hhs_sf`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/hhs_sf.md) : US
  Health and Human Services Regions Shapefile
- [`hsa_sf`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/hsa_sf.md) : US
  Hospital Service Area Shapefile
- [`state_sf`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/state_sf.md) :
  US States Shapefile
- [`state_territories_sf`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/state_territories_sf.md)
  : US States and Territories Shapefile
- [`territories_sf`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/territories_sf.md)
  : US Territories Shapefile
- [`tribal_sf`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/tribal_sf.md) :
  US Native American Lands Shapefile
- [`simulated_data`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/simulated_data.md)
  : Simulated Time Series data
- [`rnssp_stopwords`](https://cdcgov.github.io/Rnssp/reference/rnssp_stopwords.md)
  : Rnssp Stopwords
